verdict.rationale: Shopify documents its own POS system and says merchants can sell online and in person, with orders from all sales channels in one place, so in-person selling is a first-party capability. The pack does not show that the POS shares the same catalog, inventory and customer records as the online store, which is the core of this story. Missing for 10: documented shared product catalog between POS and online store, unified inventory sync across channels, shared customer profiles, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can sell in person with a point-of-sale that shares the same catalog, inventory, and customers as my online store

citations.quote: From first sale to full scale, today’s best brands run on Shopify’s POS system.
